subject: Status of our shipment HAM to GRU, 1353 kg
body:
Hello,

could you please tell me the current status of our shipment: Hofmann Textilwerk KG, HAM to GRU, 1353 kg, ready on 2026-11-29? Where is it now?

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The sender asks for the shipment’s current status and location.
